756	/-! ## O13 `free` (§70) -/
757	
758	/-- The holder is a place (§70.1). -/
759	def Holder.isPlace : Holder → Bool
760	  | .place _ => true
761	  | .frame _ => false
762	
763	/-- `OwnedRoot` (§70.1): a place with no structural parent, owned by a place. -/
764	def OwnedRoot (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop :=
765	  OptP (s.P[p]?) (fun pl => pl.parent = none ∧ pl.owner.isPlace = true) False
766	
767	/-- Decidability of `OwnedRoot` (§70.1). -/
768	instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Decidable (OwnedRoot s p) := by
769	  unfold OwnedRoot; infer_instance
770	
771	/-- Place `q` belongs to the unit released by `free p` (§70): a part of `p`, or storage owned by
772	`p`, transitively. -/
773	def FreedPlace (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Prop := partOf P q p ∨ OwnedIn P p q
774	
775	/-- Decidability of `FreedPlace` (§70). -/
776	instance (P : List Place) (p q : Nat) : Decidable (FreedPlace P p q) := by
777	  unfold FreedPlace; infer_instance
778	
779	/-- `free p` before releasing authorities whose holder died (§70, `ok` effect): the released unit
780	is marked dead; authorities covering it, roots included, or held within `p` become inactive. -/
781	def freeS (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
782	  { s with
783	    dead := fun q => s.dead q || decide (FreedPlace s.P p q)
784	    A := s.A.map fun y =>
785	      if (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, FreedPlace s.P p l) ∨ heldIn s.P p y.holder then
786	        { y with active := false } else y }
787	
788	/-- Effect of `free p` (§70, `ok` effect): `freeS`, then the authorities whose holder died are
789	released. -/
790	def freeEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 := cleanup (freeS s p)
791	
792	/-- Leaf of the released unit (§70.3, §70.4): a leaf of `p` or of storage that stops being
793	usable. -/
794	def FreedLeaf (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Prop :=
795	  l ∈ footprint s.P p ∨ (isLeaf s.P l ∧ s.Usable l ∧ ¬ (freeS s p).Usable l)
796	
797	/-- Decidability of `FreedLeaf` (§70). -/
798	instance (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Decidable (FreedLeaf s p l) := by
799	  unfold FreedLeaf; infer_instance
800	
801	/-- Authority `j` does not block `free p` (§70.3): if it is an active derivative over the
802	footprint being freed, it is held within `p` or its holder dies. -/
803	def FreeAccessOK (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : Prop :=
804	  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
805	    (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, FreedLeaf s p l) →
806	      heldIn s.P p y.holder ∨ ¬ HolderLive (freeS s p) y.holder) True

815	  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => ¬ (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, FreedPlace s.P p l) ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P p y.holder ∧

824	  /-- §70.1: `place` is an `OwnedRoot`. -/
825	  ownedRoot : OwnedRoot s p

827	  deallocable : k.Deallocable p

847	    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (freeS s p).Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, FreeAnchorOK s p x) ∧

858	/-- Static preconditions of `alloc provider owner shape` (§71, items 1–3). -/
859	structure AllocStatic (k : K) (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : Prop where
860	  /-- §71.1: the shape is nonempty. -/
861	  nonempty : ls ≠ []
862	  /-- §71.1: the shape is represented like the locals of `enterFrame` (each parent is an earlier
863	  element). -/
864	  shapeOK : ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape
865	  /-- §71.1 with the `ok` outcome of §71 ("a new storage root"): exactly one element has no
866	  parent. -/
867	  oneRoot : (rootIdx ls.toShape).length = 1
868	  /-- §71.2: all leaves of the provider are `Init`. -/
869	  providerInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P provider, s.I l = .init
870	  /-- §71.2: metadata updates are permitted through exercisable `Modify` on the provider or a
871	  valid `writeShared` (§68) over its leaves. -/
872	  providerRight : HasRight s .modify provider ∨
873	    ∃ via ∈ List.range s.A.length, WriteSharedPre k s via (footprint s.P provider)
874	  /-- §71.3: exercisable `Modify` over `owner`. -/
875	  ownerRight : HasRight s .modify owner
876	  /-- §71.3 (liveness restrictions): `owner` is usable. -/
877	  ownerUsable : s.Usable owner
878	
879	/-- Decidability of the static preconditions of `alloc` (§71). -/
880	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (provider owner : Nat)
881	    (ls : LocalShape) : Decidable (AllocStatic k s provider owner ls) :=
882	  decidable_of_iff (ls ≠ [] ∧ ShapeOK s.P.length ls.toShape ∧ (rootIdx ls.toShape).length = 1 ∧
883	    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P provider, s.I l = .init) ∧
884	    (HasRight s .modify provider ∨
885	      ∃ via ∈ List.range s.A.length, WriteSharedPre k s via (footprint s.P provider)) ∧
886	    HasRight s .modify owner ∧ s.Usable owner)
887	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩,
888	     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩⟩
889	
890	/-- Places after `alloc` (§71, `ok` outcome): the elements of the shape appended, owned by
891	`owner`. -/
892	def allocP (s : S3) (owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : List Place :=
893	  shapeP s.P (.place owner) ls.toShape
894	
895	/-- Effect of `alloc` (§71, `ok` outcome): a new storage root of fresh identities owned by
896	`owner`, its leaves `Uninit`, no anchor, alive, unpinned, with a root `Modify` authority with no
897	origin held by `owner`. -/
898	def allocEff (s : S3) (owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) : S3 :=
899	  { s with
900	    P := allocP s owner ls
901	    I := fun l => if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l
902	    A := s.A ++ (rootIdx ls.toShape).map fun i =>
903	      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (allocP s owner ls) (s.P.length + i),
904	        shapeOwner ls.toShape (.place owner) i, true⟩
905	    D := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then [] else s.D q
906	    dead := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.dead q
907	    pin := fun q => if s.P.length ≤ q then false else s.pin q }
908	
909	/-- `alloc provider owner shape` as a relation (§71 outcomes, §58): `reject` when a static
910	precondition fails; `fail`, state unchanged, when `K.Satisfiable` is false; `ok` otherwise. -/
911	inductive AllocStep (k : K) (provider owner : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) (s : S3) :
912	    Outcome3 S3 → Prop where
913	  | ok : AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → k.Satisfiable provider ls s →
914	      AllocStep k provider owner ls s (.ok (allocEff s owner ls))
915	  | fail : AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → ¬ k.Satisfiable provider ls s →
916	      AllocStep k provider owner ls s .fail
917	  | reject : ¬ AllocStatic k s provider owner ls → AllocStep k provider owner ls s .reject

922	structure PinPre (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop where
923	  /-- §74: `place` is usable. -/
924	  usable : s.Usable p
925	  /-- §74: exercisable `Modify` over the leaves of `place`. -/
926	  right : HasRight s .modify p

930	  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p)
931	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩
932	
933	/-- Effect of `pin` (`b = true`, §74) and `unpin` (`b = false`, §75): the dynamic pinning flag of
934	the leaves of `place`. -/
935	def pinEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) (b : Bool) : S3 :=
936	  { s with pin := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P p then b else s.pin l }
937	
938	/-- `pin` as a relation (§74). -/
939	def PinStep (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop := Guarded (PinPre s p) (pinEff s p true)
940	
941	/-- Preconditions of `unpin` (§75). -/
942	structure UnpinPre (k : K) (s : S3) (p : Nat) : Prop where
943	  /-- §75: `place` is usable. -/
944	  usable : s.Usable p
945	  /-- §75: exercisable `Modify` over `place`. -/
946	  right : HasRight s .modify p
947	  /-- §75: `K.ExternalDone(place)`. -/
948	  externalDone : k.ExternalDone p

951	instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] (s : S3) (p : Nat) :
952	    Decidable (UnpinPre k s p) :=
953	  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable p ∧ HasRight s .modify p ∧ k.ExternalDone p)
954	    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩⟩
955	
956	/-- `unpin` as a relation (§75). -/
957	def UnpinStep (k : K) (p : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
958	  Guarded (UnpinPre k s p) (pinEff s p false)

960	/-! ## Kernel steps (§57, §58) -/
961	
962	/-- One `ok` transition of a kernel operation O1–O16 (§60–§75; §57 reachability). -/
963	inductive KStep (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where
964	  | derive {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {region : List Nat} {m : Mode} :
965	      DeriveStep src region m s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
966	  | split {s s' : S3} {src : Nat} {rs : List (List Nat)} :
967	      SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
968	  | release {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} : ReleaseStep a s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
969	  | transfer {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
970	  | depend {s s' : S3} {q x : Nat} : DependStep q x s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
971	  | enter {s s' : S3} {ps : List Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
972	      EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
973	  | exit {s s' : S3} : ExitStep k s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
974	  | read {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Read3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
975	  | write {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} : Write3Step a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
976	  | writeShared {s s' : S3} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} :
977	      WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
978	  | pin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : PinStep p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
979	  | unpin {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : UnpinStep k p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
980	  | endUse {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} : EndUseStep k p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
981	  | free {s s' : S3} {p auth : Nat} : FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
982	  | alloc {s s' : S3} {pr ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} :
983	      AllocStep k pr ow ls s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
984	  | store {s s' : S3} {a p : Nat} : StoreStep a p s (.ok s') → KStep k s s'
985	
986	end Ern.MemoryModel.Access

1	import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Ops
2	
3	/-!
4	# Access kernel: invariants, initial state, reachability
5	
6	`WF3` (§49), `I1`–`I4` (§50–§53), `NoDangling` and `NoOrphan` (§54), `Inv3` (§57), the declared
7	statics and `S3.init` (§47), `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75), and reachability from `S3.init statics`
8	under the kernel steps O1–O16 (§57). `AnchorOrder` and `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44) are in
9	`Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Basic`, since operations read them.
10	-/
11	
12	namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access
13	
14	/-! ## Root places and root authorities (§40, §49) -/
15	
16	/-- Root place (§40): an existing place with no structural parent. -/
17	def RootPlace (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Prop := r < P.length ∧ parentOf P r = none
18	
19	/-- Decidability of `RootPlace` (§40). -/
20	instance (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Decidable (RootPlace P r) :=
21	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))
22	
23	/-- `RootChain` (§49.6): the origin chain of an authority covering a leaf ends at a root
24	authority (no origin) whose footprint is the footprint of a root place containing that leaf. -/
25	def RootChain (s : S3) : Prop :=
26	  ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority) (l : Nat), s.A[a]? = some y → l ∈ y.footprint → isLeaf s.P l →
27	    ∃ x z r, (x = a ∨ x ∈ s.ancs a) ∧ s.A[x]? = some z ∧ z.origin = none ∧ RootPlace s.P r ∧
28	      partOf s.P l r ∧ ∀ l', l' ∈ z.footprint ↔ l' ∈ footprint s.P r
29	
30	/-- `RootHeld` (§49.7, §40): every usable root place has an active root authority of own mode
31	`Modify`, with no origin, held by the owner of the place, whose footprint is the footprint of the
32	place. -/
33	def RootHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
34	  ∀ r, RootPlace s.P r → s.Usable r → ∃ (i : Nat) (z : Authority) (pr : Place),
35	    s.A[i]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧ z.origin = none ∧ z.mode = .modify ∧
36	    s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P r
37	
38	/-- Auxiliary converse of `RootHeld` (§40, §49.7), not a clause of `WF3`: an authority with no
39	origin is held by the owner of the root place of every leaf it covers. -/
40	def RootHeldConv (s : S3) : Prop :=
41	  ∀ (x : Nat) (z : Authority) (l r : Nat), s.A[x]? = some z → z.origin = none → l ∈ z.footprint →
42	    RootPlace s.P r → partOf s.P l r → ∃ pr, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner
43	
44	/-! ## `WF3` (§49) -/
45	
46	/-- `WF3(s)` (§49): one field per item of §49. Index order of parents and origins represents
47	acyclicity (§49, last paragraph). -/
48	structure WF3 (s : S3) : Prop where
49	  /-- §49.1: the stack is nonempty and duplicate-free, every frame below `nF`. -/
50	  frames : s.F ≠ [] ∧ s.F.Nodup ∧ ∀ f ∈ s.F, f < s.nF
51	  /-- §49.2: parent links are valid and acyclic (the parent precedes the child); a part shares
52	  its parent's owner and death marker. -/
53	  places : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (r : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.parent = some r →
54	    ∃ pr : Place, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ r < q ∧ pr.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead r = s.dead q
55	  /-- §49.3: owner frames are below `nF`; owner places exist; the ownership chain of every usable
56	  place is finite and reaches a live frame. -/
57	  owners : (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .frame f →
58	      f < s.nF) ∧
59	    (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o →
60	      o < s.P.length) ∧
61	    ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∃ f, FrameOf s q f ∧ f ∈ s.F
62	  /-- §49.4: footprints consist of leaves of existing places. -/
63	  footprints : ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint,
64	    l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l

66	  root authority. -/
67	  origins : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b

71	  rootHeld : RootHeld s

73	  holders : ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
74	    HolderLive s y.holder

76	/-! ## `I1`–`I4`, `NoDangling`, `Inv3` (§50–§54, §57) -/
77	
78	/-- `I1` (§50): two distinct active authorities unrelated by derivation covering a common leaf
79	both have own mode `Observe`. -/
80	def I1 (s : S3) : Prop :=
81	  ∀ (a b : Nat) (x y : Authority) (p : Nat), a ≠ b → s.A[a]? = some x → s.A[b]? = some y →
82	    x.active = true → y.active = true → p ∈ x.footprint → p ∈ y.footprint →
83	    a ∉ s.ancs b → b ∉ s.ancs a → x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe
84	
85	/-- `I2` (§51): the origin of a derived authority exists; the derived mode does not exceed the
86	origin's and the derived footprint is within the origin's. -/
87	def I2 (s : S3) : Prop :=
88	  ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a →
89	    ∃ x : Authority, s.A[a]? = some x ∧ y.mode.le x.mode ∧ ∀ p ∈ y.footprint, p ∈ x.footprint
90

92	def I3 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x

94	/-- `I4` (§53, first sentence): no read of a region containing a `Moved` leaf is permitted. -/
95	def I4 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (l : Nat), l ∈ ls → s.I l = .moved →
96	  ¬ Read3Pre s a ls

102	def NoDangling (s : S3) : Prop :=
103	  ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →
104	    ∀ q, ¬ s.Usable q → ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∉ y.footprint
105	
106	/-- `Inv3 = I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4 ∧ AnchorOrder ∧ NoDangling` (§57). -/
107	def Inv3 (s : S3) : Prop := Inv3base s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ NoDangling s

112	place holding `b`. -/

114	  OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun z => match z.holder with
115	    | .place q => s.Active a ∧ ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∈ s.afp a
116	    | .frame _ => False) False

118	/-- Consecutive elements of a list are related by `R` (§54, chains of `NoOrphan`). -/
119	def Linked (R : Nat → Nat → Prop) : List Nat → Prop
120	  | a :: b :: c => R a b ∧ Linked R (b :: c)
121	  | _ => True

123	/-- `NoOrphan` (§54): every active authority held by a place ends a finite, non-repeating chain of
124	authorities whose first link is active and held by a frame of the stack, each link covering the
125	whole place holding the next. -/
126	def NoOrphan (s : S3) : Prop :=
127	  ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (q : Nat), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
128	    ∃ (a₀ : Nat) (z : Authority) (f : Nat) (c : List Nat), s.A[a₀]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧
129	      z.holder = .frame f ∧ f ∈ s.F ∧ (a₀ :: c).Nodup ∧ (a₀ :: c).getLast? = some x ∧
130	      Linked (CoversHolder s) (a₀ :: c)

132	/-! ## Initial state (§47) -/
133	
134	/-- Declared static storage (§47): each element is (parent, owning static, kind) with its
135	initial state, `true` for `Init` and `false` for `Uninit` (read on leaves only). -/
136	abbrev Statics := List ((Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) × Bool)
137	
138	/-- Well-formed statics declaration (§47; not stated by §47, a hypothesis of the theorems on the
139	initial state): parents and owning statics are earlier statics, and a part has its parent's
140	owning static. -/
141	def StaticsOK (statics : Statics) : Prop := ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1))
142	
143	/-- Decidability of `StaticsOK` (§47). -/
144	instance (statics : Statics) : Decidable (StaticsOK statics) := by
145	  unfold StaticsOK; infer_instance
146	
147	/-- `S3.init statics` (§47): base frame 0 and the declared statics, owned by frame 0 or by
148	another static; one root `Modify` authority with no origin per root static, held by its owner;
149	leaves `Init` or `Uninit` as declared; no anchor, no derived authority, nothing dead or
150	pinned. -/
151	def S3.init (statics : Statics) : S3 :=
152	  { F := [0]
153	    nF := 1
154	    P := shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))
155	    I := fun l => if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then .init else .uninit
156	    A := (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))).map fun i =>
157	      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))) i,
158	        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i, true⟩
159	    D := fun _ => []
160	    dead := fun _ => false
161	    pin := fun _ => false }
162	
163	/-- `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75, §80): every static place whose leaf is designated by `K.Pinned` is
164	directly owned by the base frame 0. A condition on `(K, statics)`. -/
165	def StaticPinnedBottom (k : K) (statics : Statics) : Prop :=
166	  ∀ l < statics.length, k.Pinned l →
167	    OptP ((S3.init statics).P[l]?) (fun pl => pl.owner = .frame 0) False
168	
169	/-! ## Reachability (§57) -/
170	
171	/-- States reachable from `S3.init statics` under the kernel steps O1–O16 (§57). -/
172	inductive Reachable (k : K) (statics : Statics) : S3 → Prop where
173	  | init : Reachable k statics (S3.init statics)
174	  | step {s s' : S3} : Reachable k statics s → KStep k s s' → Reachable k statics s'

14	/-! ## Root places and root authorities (§40, §49) -/
15	
16	/-- Root place (§40): an existing place with no structural parent. -/
17	def RootPlace (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Prop := r < P.length ∧ parentOf P r = none
18	
19	/-- Decidability of `RootPlace` (§40). -/
20	instance (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Decidable (RootPlace P r) :=
21	  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))
22	
23	/-- `RootChain` (§49.6): the origin chain of an authority covering a leaf ends at a root
24	authority (no origin) whose footprint is the footprint of a root place containing that leaf. -/
25	def RootChain (s : S3) : Prop :=
26	  ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority) (l : Nat), s.A[a]? = some y → l ∈ y.footprint → isLeaf s.P l →
27	    ∃ x z r, (x = a ∨ x ∈ s.ancs a) ∧ s.A[x]? = some z ∧ z.origin = none ∧ RootPlace s.P r ∧
28	      partOf s.P l r ∧ ∀ l', l' ∈ z.footprint ↔ l' ∈ footprint s.P r
29	
30	/-- `RootHeld` (§49.7, §40): every usable root place has an active root authority of own mode
31	`Modify`, with no origin, held by the owner of the place, whose footprint is the footprint of the
32	place. -/
33	def RootHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
34	  ∀ r, RootPlace s.P r → s.Usable r → ∃ (i : Nat) (z : Authority) (pr : Place),
35	    s.A[i]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧ z.origin = none ∧ z.mode = .modify ∧
36	    s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P r
37	
38	/-- Auxiliary converse of `RootHeld` (§40, §49.7), not a clause of `WF3`: an authority with no
39	origin is held by the owner of the root place of every leaf it covers. -/
40	def RootHeldConv (s : S3) : Prop :=
41	  ∀ (x : Nat) (z : Authority) (l r : Nat), s.A[x]? = some z → z.origin = none → l ∈ z.footprint →
42	    RootPlace s.P r → partOf s.P l r → ∃ pr, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Invariants

/-!
# Access kernel: shared lemmas

Lemmas shared by the preservation proofs of the kernel operations of
`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md` §60–§75: origin and parent chains (§40, §42),
footprints and frames of places (§40), effective modes (§43) and their exclusivity under `I1`
(§50), additions of authorities (§42, §60, §61), states with the same authorities up to holders
(§63), consequences of `WF3` (§49), usability (§40), root places (§40, §49.6, §49.7), the shape of
`transfer` (§63), and `NoOrphan` from `WF3` (§54).
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Chains (§40, §42, §49) -/

/-- A chain from an element without link is empty (§40 parents, §42 origins). -/
theorem chainF_none {org : Nat → Option Nat} {i : Nat} (h : org i = none) :
    ∀ k, chainF org k i = []
  | 0 => rfl
  | _ + 1 => by simp [chainF, h]

/-- Any fuel at least the start index gives the same chain (§40, §42; acyclicity, §49). -/
theorem chainF_fuel (org : Nat → Option Nat) :
    ∀ k₁ k₂ i, i ≤ k₁ → i ≤ k₂ → chainF org k₁ i = chainF org k₂ i
  | 0, 0, _, _, _ => rfl
  | 0, _ + 1, i, h, _ => by
    obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
    simp only [chainF]; split <;> simp
  | _ + 1, 0, i, _, h => by
    obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
    simp only [chainF]; split <;> simp
  | k₁ + 1, k₂ + 1, i, h₁, h₂ => by
    simp only [chainF]; split
    · split
      · rw [chainF_fuel org k₁ k₂ _ (by omega) (by omega)]
      · rfl
    · rfl

/-- `split` adds its authorities one region at a time (§61, `ok` effect). -/
theorem splitEff_cons (s : S3) (src : Nat) (r : List Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) :
    splitEff s src (r :: rs) =
      splitEff (s.addAuth ⟨.modify, some src, r, .frame s.top, true⟩) src rs := by
  simp [splitEff, S3.addAuth, S3.top]

/-! ## Same authorities up to holders (§42, §63) -/

/-- Skeleton of an authority (§42): every field but its holder. -/
def skel (z : Authority) : Mode × Option Nat × List Nat × Bool :=
  (z.mode, z.origin, z.footprint, z.active)

/-- `s'` has the authorities of `s` up to their holders (§42; §63: a transfer creates and
duplicates no authority). -/
def SameSkel (s s' : S3) : Prop :=
  s'.A.length = s.A.length ∧ ∀ j : Nat, (s'.A[j]?).map skel = (s.A[j]?).map skel

/-- An authority of `s'` has a counterpart in `s` with the same skeleton (§42). -/
theorem SameSkel.get {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') {j : Nat} {y' : Authority}
    (hj : s'.A[j]? = some y') : ∃ y, s.A[j]? = some y ∧ skel y' = skel y := by
  have := h.2 j; rw [hj] at this
  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at this; cases this
  | some y => rw [hy] at this; exact ⟨y, rfl, Option.some.inj this⟩

/-- An authority of `s` has a counterpart in `s'` with the same skeleton (§42). -/
theorem SameSkel.get' {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') {j : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hj : s.A[j]? = some y) : ∃ y', s'.A[j]? = some y' ∧ skel y' = skel y := by
  have := h.2 j; rw [hj] at this
  cases hy : s'.A[j]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at this; cases this
  | some y' => rw [hy] at this; exact ⟨y', rfl, Option.some.inj this⟩

/-- Same skeletons give the same origin links (§42). -/
theorem SameSkel.org {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') : s'.org = s.org := by
  funext j
  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
  | none =>
    cases hy' : s'.A[j]? with
    | none => simp [S3.org, hy, hy']
    | some y' => obtain ⟨y, h1, -⟩ := h.get hy'; rw [hy] at h1; cases h1
  | some y => obtain ⟨y', hy', e⟩ := h.get' hy; simp [skel] at e; simp [S3.org, hy, hy', e.2.1]

/-- Same skeletons give the same origin chains (§42). -/
theorem SameSkel.ancs {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') : s'.ancs = s.ancs := by
  funext j; simp [S3.ancs, h.org]

/-- Same skeletons give the same active authorities (§42). -/
theorem SameSkel.active {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') {x : Nat} :
    s'.Active x ↔ s.Active x := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y', hy', ha⟩; obtain ⟨y, hy, he⟩ := h.get hy'
    exact ⟨y, hy, by simp [skel] at he; rw [← he.2.2.2]; exact ha⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, ha⟩; obtain ⟨y', hy', he⟩ := h.get' hy
    exact ⟨y', hy', by simp [skel] at he; rw [he.2.2.2]; exact ha⟩

/-- Same skeletons give the same covering descendants (§43). -/
theorem SameSkel.descModes {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') (a p : Nat) :
    descModes s' a p = descModes s a p := by
  unfold Access.descModes; rw [h.1, h.ancs]
  refine filterMap_congr' fun j _ => ?_
  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
  | none => have := h.2 j; rw [hy] at this; cases hy' : s'.A[j]? <;> simp_all
  | some y =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy', he⟩ := h.get' hy
    simp [skel] at he; simp [hy', he]

/-- Same skeletons give the same effective modes (§43). -/
theorem SameSkel.effective {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') (a p : Nat) :
    effective s' a p = effective s a p := by
  unfold Access.effective; rw [h.descModes]
  cases hy : s.A[a]? with
  | none => have := h.2 a; rw [hy] at this; cases hy' : s'.A[a]? <;> simp_all
  | some y =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy', he⟩ := h.get' hy
    simp [skel] at he; simp [hy', he]

/-- `I1` depends only on the skeletons (§50). -/
theorem SameSkel.i1 {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') (h1 : I1 s) : I1 s' := by
  intro a b x' y' p hab ha hb xa ya xp yp hnab hnba
  obtain ⟨x, hx, ex⟩ := h.get ha; obtain ⟨y, hy, ey⟩ := h.get hb
  simp [skel] at ex ey; rw [h.ancs] at hnab hnba
  rw [ex.1, ey.1]
  exact h1 a b x y p hab hx hy (ex.2.2.2 ▸ xa) (ey.2.2.2 ▸ ya) (ex.2.2.1 ▸ xp) (ey.2.2.1 ▸ yp)
    hnab hnba

/-- `I2` depends only on the skeletons (§51). -/
theorem SameSkel.i2 {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') (h2 : I2 s) : I2 s' := by
  intro b y a hb ho
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e⟩ := h.get hb; simp [skel] at e
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hm, hh⟩ := h2 b y₀ a hy₀ (e.2.1 ▸ ho)
  obtain ⟨x', hx', e'⟩ := h.get' hx₀; simp [skel] at e'
  exact ⟨x', hx', by rw [e.1, e'.1]; exact hm,
    fun p hp => by rw [e'.2.2.1]; exact hh p (e.2.2.1 ▸ hp)⟩

/-- The origin clause of `WF3` depends only on the skeletons (§49.5). -/
theorem SameSkel.origins {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s')
    (hw : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b) :
    ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s'.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b := by
  intro b y a hb ho
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e⟩ := h.get hb; simp [skel] at e
  exact hw b y₀ a hy₀ (e.2.1 ▸ ho)

/-- A property of every footprint member depends only on the skeletons (§49.4). -/
theorem SameSkel.footprints {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') {Q : Nat → Prop}
    (hw : ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint, Q l) :
    ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s'.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint, Q l := by
  intro a x hx l hl
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, e⟩ := h.get hx; simp [skel] at e
  exact hw a x₀ hx₀ l (e.2.2.1 ▸ hl)

/-! ## `release` (§62) -/

/-- Element `j` after setting element `a` (§62, §65 effects). -/
theorem set_get {l : List Authority} {a j : Nat} {x' : Authority} (ha : a < l.length) :
    (l.set a x')[j]? = if a = j then some x' else l[j]? := by
  rw [List.getElem?_set]; split <;> simp_all

(§49.6). -/
theorem rootChain_addAuth {s : S3} (h : RootChain s) {src : Nat} {x y₀ : Authority}
    (hx : s.A[src]? = some x) (ho : y₀.origin = some src)
    (hfp : ∀ p ∈ y₀.footprint, p ∈ x.footprint) : RootChain (s.addAuth y₀) := by
  have hs := lt_of_getElem? hx
  intro a y l ha hl hleaf
  rcases addAuth_get ha with ⟨ha', ha''⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · obtain ⟨x0, z, r, hx0, hz, rest⟩ := h a y l ha'' hl hleaf
    have hx0lt : x0 < s.A.length := by
      rcases hx0 with rfl | hx0
      · exact ha'
      · exact Nat.lt_trans (chain_lt hx0) ha'

      rcases hx0 with rfl | hx0
      · exact hs
      · exact Nat.lt_trans (chain_lt hx0) hs
    refine ⟨x0, z, r, .inr ?_, by rw [addAuth_lt hx0lt]; exact hz, rest⟩
    rw [ancs_addAuth_self ho hs]
    rcases hx0 with rfl | hx0
    · exact List.mem_cons_self ..
    · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx0

of `src` on each leaf of its footprint preserves `I1` (§50, §60.2, §60.3). -/
theorem addAuth_I1 {s : S3} (ht : I1 s) {src : Nat} {x : Authority} {m : Mode} {fp : List Nat}
    {hd : Holder} (hx : s.A[src]? = some x) (hal : ∀ p ∈ fp, Allows (effective s src p) m) :
    I1 (s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, fp, hd, true⟩) := by

  have hxp : ∀ p ∈ fp, x.active = true ∧ p ∈ x.footprint := fun p hp => by

    rcases addAuth_get hb with ⟨hb', hb''⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

  · rw [ancs_addAuth_self rfl hs] at hnba
    exact new_vs_old ht hx (hxp p xp).1 (hxp p xp).2 (hal p xp) hb'' ya' yp

leaf, and a live holder, preserves `WF3` (§49) and `I1`–`I4` (§50–§53). Shared by `derive` (§60)
and `split` (§61). -/
theorem addAuth_preserves {s : S3} (hwf : WF3 s) (hinv : Inv3base s) {src : Nat} {x : Authority}
    {m : Mode} {fp : List Nat} {hd : Holder} (hx : s.A[src]? = some x) (hm : m.le x.mode)
    (hfp : ∀ p ∈ fp, p ∈ x.footprint) (hal : ∀ p ∈ fp, Allows (effective s src p) m)
    (hl : HolderLive s hd) :
    WF3 (s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, fp, hd, true⟩) ∧
      Inv3base (s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, fp, hd, true⟩) := by
  obtain ⟨i1, i2, i3, -⟩ := hinv
  have hs := lt_of_getElem? hx
  have live := HolderLive.congr (addAuth_P s ⟨m, some src, fp, hd, true⟩) rfl rfl
  have usable := fun q => S3.Usable.congr (q := q) (addAuth_P s ⟨m, some src, fp, hd, true⟩) rfl rfl
  refine ⟨⟨hwf.frames, hwf.places, ⟨hwf.owners.1, hwf.owners.2.1, fun q hq => ?_⟩, ?_, ?_,
    rootChain_addAuth hwf.rootChain hx rfl hfp,
    hwf.rootHeld.transport rfl (fun r => (usable r).1)
      (fun i z hz _ _ => by rw [addAuth_lt (lt_of_getElem? hz)]; exact hz), ?_⟩,
    addAuth_I1 i1 hx hal, ?_, fun q hq y hy => active_addAuth (i3 q ((usable q).1 hq) y hy),
    i4_always _⟩
  · obtain ⟨f, hf, hfF⟩ := hwf.owners.2.2 q ((usable q).1 hq)
    exact ⟨f, (FrameOf.congr (addAuth_P s _)).2 hf, hfF⟩

content.content:
# Formalization design

Decisions for the Lean formalization. They govern how to formalize, never what ERN means: semantics comes only from `specs/`. Agents follow them. A design question not settled here is proposed in the report, never decided silently.

## Goal

Check that the spec's rules deliver what ERN promises. A rule that cannot be formalized or proven as written is a result: report it with the failing goal, never work around it.

Three results stay distinct: the formal model of the rules, the theorems proven about that model, and later the correctness of the compiler against it. This formalization covers the first two.

## Architecture

The formalization uses two permanent, complementary models linked
by a refinement theorem.

This is an architectural decision about formalization, not a
normative decision about ERN semantics. Both models must faithfully
represent the validated specifications.

If a specification cannot be represented faithfully, the mismatch
must be reported. Any necessary change to the formalization
architecture requires an explicit revision of this document.

1. **Abstract model.** Memory is a set of places: variables and field paths (`p.right`). Gives the semantics of safe code. States what safe code may assume about memory.
2. **Concrete model.** Memory is byte-addressed allocations. Gives the semantics of safe and unsafe code. Parameterized by a layout interface, never by a fixed layout.
3. **Refinement theorem.** Links the two models. It is the formal statement of ERN's safety promise.

## Concrete memory

- Bytes are abstract: each byte carries its initialization state and, when it belongs to a pointer, its provenance. Address and provenance are distinct.
- The concrete model represents every distinction the spec's rules rely on, including storage shared by several places.

## Layout interface

- Size, alignment and position of each component of a type are abstract functions.
- Their guarantees (in bounds, non-overlapping where the spec requires it, aligned) are hypotheses carried as structure fields or typeclass assumptions, never Lean `axiom`s.
- The interface contains only guarantees that some spec rule needs. Each hypothesis cites the rule that requires it.
- Non-vacuity: whenever the interface changes, a layout satisfying it is exhibited and proven. An unsatisfiable interface would make every refinement result empty.
- Realizability for every admissible target and instance is an obligation of the charter's ABI and layout step. It stays recorded as open until that step discharges it.

## Main theorems

- **Observable behaviors** are defined explicitly: termination with its observable result, trap, undefined behavior, divergence. Refinement compares concrete behaviors projected onto abstract observations.
- **Abstract safety.** A program accepted by the static rules has no undefined behavior in the abstract model.
- **Refinement.** For every layout satisfying the interface: if each unsafe region satisfies its contract, every observable behavior of an accepted program in the concrete model projects to a behavior of the abstract model. Concrete safety follows from abstract safety.
- **Unsafe contracts.** A contract is an entry condition and an exit condition relating the two models. From any state satisfying the entry condition, no execution of the region reaches undefined behavior, and every non-trap exit satisfies the exit condition. A trap is terminal: it runs no cleanup and is compared as an observable behavior. The relation between the models implies the entry condition of any region reachable from safe code; a stronger entry condition must be established by the unsafe code that enters the region. Intermediate states may break the relation, since in sequential execution no other code observes them. Under concurrency, shared state is observable during the region; the contract form for that case is decided before milestone 4.
- **Scope.** Every theorem states the language fragment it covers. A theorem on a fragment supports no claim about the whole language; sequential safety implies nothing about concurrent safety.

## Construction order

1. Control flow infrastructure: abstract syntax and operational semantics of control constructs. No safety theorem yet: the control flow spec's preservation rule depends on the memory and concurrency models.
2. Memory model, safe part, on the abstract model. Abstract safety for the sequential fragment.
3. Concrete model, layout interface and refinement for the sequential fragment. The memory model counts as verified for that fragment only once refinement is proven.
4. Concurrency model: extends both models and the refinement.
5. IR dialect, once its dependencies are formalized.

The semantic style of milestones 4 and 5 and their target theorems are decided here before they start.

## Representation

- **Abstract syntax** is built incrementally: only the constructs required by the rules being formalized. No concrete syntax.
- **Semantics** is a step function where the spec is deterministic, a step relation where it is not. Interpreters for tests iterate steps with fuel. Running out of fuel is not an outcome, neither termination nor trap. Each interpreter is proven to agree with the unbounded semantics on every result it returns.
- **No Mathlib** unless a milestone requires it. Adding it is a design decision recorded here.

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.Common

/-!
# Access kernel: preservation by `depend`, `store`, `read`, `write`, `writeShared`, `pin`, `unpin`

Every `ok` step of O5 `depend` (§64), O8 `store` (§65), O9 `read` (§66), O10 `write` (§67), O11
`writeShared` (§68), O15 `pin` (§74) and O16 `unpin` (§75) preserves the kernel invariant `KInv`
of §57 and, separately, the auxiliary invariant `KAux` (§58: an `ok` transition preserves the
relevant invariants). Per-invariant lemmas come first, then the clause-level properties of these operations
and their determinism (§58).
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Transport of the invariants (§44, §49–§54) -/

/-- Equal authority lists have the same skeletons (§42). -/
private theorem skel_of_A {s s' : S3} (hA : s'.A = s.A) : SameSkel s s' :=
  ⟨by rw [hA], fun j => by rw [hA]⟩

/-- Under the origin order of `WF3` (§49.5), the effective anchor of `x` has no origin: it is the
root reached along the origin chain (§44). -/
private theorem effAnchor_root {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) :
    ∀ n x, x < n → s.org (s.effAnchor x) = none
  | 0, _, h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, x, hx => by
    cases ho : s.org x with
    | none => simp [S3.effAnchor, S3.ancs, chain_none ho, ho]
    | some o =>
      have hlt : o < x := by
        simp only [S3.org] at ho
        cases hy : s.A[x]? with
        | none => rw [hy] at ho; cases ho
        | some y => rw [hy] at ho; exact hw.origins x y o hy ho
      have e : s.effAnchor x = s.effAnchor o := by
        simp only [S3.effAnchor, S3.ancs, chain_cons ho hlt, List.getLastD_cons]
      rw [e]; exact effAnchor_root hw n o (by omega)

/-- `EffAnchorOK` (§44) depends only on the authorities, the places and the stack. -/
private theorem effAnchorOK_of_A {s s' : S3} (hA : s'.A = s.A) (hP : s'.P = s.P)
    (hF : s'.F = s.F) (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : EffAnchorOK s' x fd ↔ EffAnchorOK s x fd := by
  have he : s'.effAnchor x = s.effAnchor x := by simp only [S3.effAnchor, (skel_of_A hA).ancs]
  unfold EffAnchorOK; rw [he, hA, hF]; simp only [S3.hframe_congr hP]

/-- `EffAnchorOK` (§44) is unchanged by a step that keeps the places, the stack, the skeletons of
the authorities and every authority with no origin: under `WF3` (§49.5) the effective anchor has
no origin. -/
private theorem effAnchorOK_skel {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (sk : SameSkel s s') (hP : s'.P = s.P)
    (hF : s'.F = s.F)
    (hroot : ∀ (i : Nat) (z : Authority), z.origin = none → (s'.A[i]? = some z ↔ s.A[i]? = some z))
    (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat) : EffAnchorOK s' x fd ↔ EffAnchorOK s x fd := by
  have he : s'.effAnchor x = s.effAnchor x := by simp only [S3.effAnchor, sk.ancs]
  unfold EffAnchorOK
  rw [he, hF]
  cases hz : s.A[s.effAnchor x]? with
  | none =>
    have hz' : s'.A[s.effAnchor x]? = none := by
      have := sk.2 (s.effAnchor x); rw [hz] at this
      cases h : s'.A[s.effAnchor x]? with
      | none => rfl
      | some _ => rw [h] at this; cases this
    rw [hz']; exact Iff.rfl
  | some z =>
    have hzo : z.origin = none := by
      have := effAnchor_root hw (x + 1) x (Nat.lt_succ_self x)
      simpa only [S3.org, hz, Option.bind_some] using this
    rw [(hroot _ z hzo).2 hz]
    simp only [OptP, S3.hframe_congr hP]

/-- `WF3` (§49) carries over to a state with the same places, stack, fresh frame bound and death
markers, the same skeletons of authorities, the same authorities with no origin, and live
holders for its active authorities. -/
private theorem wf3_skel {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (sk : SameSkel s s') (hP : s'.P = s.P)
    (hF : s'.F = s.F) (hn : s'.nF = s.nF) (hd : s'.dead = s.dead)
    (hroot : ∀ (i : Nat) (z : Authority), z.origin = none → (s'.A[i]? = some z ↔ s.A[i]? = some z))
    (hhold : ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority), s'.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
      HolderLive s y.holder) : WF3 s' :=
  { frames := by rw [hF, hn]; exact hw.frames
    places := by rw [hP, hd]; exact hw.places
    owners := by
      refine ⟨by rw [hP, hn]; exact hw.owners.1, by rw [hP]; exact hw.owners.2.1, fun q hq => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨f, hf, hfF⟩ := hw.owners.2.2 q ((S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).1 hq)
      exact ⟨f, (FrameOf.congr hP).2 hf, by rw [hF]; exact hfF⟩
    footprints := by
      rw [hP]; exact sk.footprints (Q := fun l => l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l) hw.footprints
    origins := sk.origins hw.origins
    rootChain := sk.rootChain hw.rootChain (by rw [hP]) (by rw [hP])
    rootHeld := hw.rootHeld.transport hP (fun _ hr => (S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).1 hr)
      fun i z hz _ hzo => (hroot i z hzo).2 hz
    holders := fun a y hy ya => (HolderLive.congr hP hF hd _).2 (hhold a y hy ya) }

/-- `I1`–`I4` (§50–§53) carry over to a state with the same places, stack, death markers and
skeletons of authorities, whose anchors of usable places are active. -/
private theorem inv3base_skel {s s' : S3} (hi : Inv3base s) (sk : SameSkel s s')
    (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F) (hd : s'.dead = s.dead)
    (hD : ∀ q : Nat, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s'.D q, s.Active x) : Inv3base s' := by
  obtain ⟨i1, i2, -, -⟩ := hi
  exact ⟨sk.i1 i1, sk.i2 i2,

/-- `AnchorOrder` (§44) in a state with the same places, stack and death markers and the same
`EffAnchorOK`, whose anchors of usable places satisfy the rule in the previous state. -/
private theorem anchorOrder_of {s s' : S3} (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F)
    (hd : s'.dead = s.dead)
    (heq : ∀ (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat), EffAnchorOK s' x fd ↔ EffAnchorOK s x fd)
    (hD : ∀ q : Nat, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s'.D q, EffAnchorOK s x (s.pframe q)) : AnchorOrder s' :=
  fun q hq x hx => by
    rw [heq, S3.pframe_congr hP]; exact hD q ((S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).1 hq) x hx

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44) carries over to a state with the same places, stack and death markers
and the same `EffAnchorOK`, whose active authorities are active with the same holder before. -/
private theorem anchorOrderHeld_of {s s' : S3} (h : AnchorOrderHeld s) (hP : s'.P = s.P)
    (hF : s'.F = s.F) (hd : s'.dead = s.dead)
    (heq : ∀ (x : Nat) (fd : Option Nat), EffAnchorOK s' x fd ↔ EffAnchorOK s x fd)
    (hback : ∀ (x : Nat) (y' : Authority), s'.A[x]? = some y' → y'.active = true →
      ∃ y, s.A[x]? = some y ∧ y.active = true ∧ y.holder = y'.holder) : AnchorOrderHeld s' := by
  intro q hq x y' hy ya hh
  obtain ⟨y, hy0, ya0, hh0⟩ := hback x y' hy ya
  rw [heq, S3.pframe_congr hP]
  exact h q ((S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).1 hq) x y hy0 ya0 (hh0.trans hh)

/-- `NoDangling` (§54) carries over to a state with the same places, stack, death markers and
skeletons of authorities. -/
private theorem noDangling_skel {s s' : S3} (h : NoDangling s) (sk : SameSkel s s')
    (hP : s'.P = s.P) (hF : s'.F = s.F) (hd : s'.dead = s.dead) : NoDangling s' := by
  intro j y hy ya q hq l hl hly
  obtain ⟨y0, hy0, e⟩ := sk.get hy
  simp only [skel, Prod.mk.injEq] at e
  rw [hP] at hl
  exact h j y0 hy0 (by rw [← e.2.2.2]; exact ya) q
    (fun hu => hq ((S3.Usable.congr hP hF hd).2 hu)) l hl (by rw [← e.2.2.1]; exact hly)

/-- `RootHeldConv` (§40, §49.7) carries over to a state with the same places whose authorities
with no origin are authorities of the previous state. -/
private theorem rootHeldConv_of {s s' : S3} (h : RootHeldConv s) (hP : s'.P = s.P)
    (hroot : ∀ (i : Nat) (z : Authority), z.origin = none → s'.A[i]? = some z → s.A[i]? = some z) :
    RootHeldConv s' :=
  h.transport hP fun x z hx hzo => ⟨z, hroot x z hzo hx, hzo, rfl, rfl⟩

/-- The chain of an element without link is empty (§40, §42). -/
theorem chain_none {org : Nat → Option Nat} {i : Nat} (h : org i = none) : chain org i = [] :=
  chainF_none h i

/-- The chain of `i` is its link followed by the chain of the link (§40, §42). -/
theorem chain_cons {org : Nat → Option Nat} {i o : Nat} (h : org i = some o) (hlt : o < i) :
    chain org i = o :: chain org o := by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, i = k + 1 := ⟨i - 1, by omega⟩
  simp only [chain, chainF, h, hlt, ↓reduceIte]
  rw [chainF_fuel org k o o (by omega) (Nat.le_refl o)]

/-- Elements of a chain are below its start (§49, acyclic chains). -/
theorem chainF_lt {org : Nat → Option Nat} : ∀ k i j, j ∈ chainF org k i → j < i
  | 0, _, _, h => by simp [chainF] at h
  | k + 1, i, j, h => by
    simp only [chainF] at h; split at h
    · split at h
      · rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h
        · assumption
        · exact Nat.lt_trans (chainF_lt k _ j h) ‹_›
      · simp at h
    · simp at h

/-- Every element of a chain is below its start (§49, acyclic chains). -/
theorem chain_lt {org : Nat → Option Nat} {i j : Nat} (h : j ∈ chain org i) : j < i :=
  chainF_lt i i j h

/-- A chain within fuel `k` has at most `k` elements (§49, finite chains). -/
theorem chainF_length {org : Nat → Option Nat} : ∀ k i, (chainF org k i).length ≤ k
  | 0, _ => by simp [chainF]
  | k + 1, i => by
    simp only [chainF]; split
    · split
      · simp only [List.length_cons]; have := chainF_length (org := org) k ‹_›; omega
      · simp
    · simp

/-- A chain from `i` has at most `i` elements (§49, finite chains). -/
theorem chain_length (org : Nat → Option Nat) (i : Nat) : (chain org i).length ≤ i :=
  chainF_length i i

/-- A chain depends only on the links at or below its start (§40, §42). -/
theorem chainF_congr {org org' : Nat → Option Nat} :
    ∀ k i, (∀ j ≤ i, org j = org' j) → chainF org k i = chainF org' k i
  | 0, _, _ => rfl
  | k + 1, i, h => by
    simp only [chainF]; rw [h i (Nat.le_refl i)]; split
    · split
      · rw [chainF_congr k _ fun j hj => h j (by omega)]

    · rfl

/-- A chain depends only on the links at or below its start (§40, §42). -/
theorem chain_congr {org org' : Nat → Option Nat} {i : Nat} (h : ∀ j ≤ i, org j = org' j) :

/-- Two elements without link of one chain are equal (§40 root places, §49.5 root

theorem chainF_root {org : Nat → Option Nat} : ∀ k i r r', r ∈ chainF org k i → org r = none →

  | 0, _, _, _, h, _, _, _ => by simp [chainF] at h

theorem writeShared_det {k : K} {a : Nat} {ls : List Nat} {s : S3} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 S3}

/-! ## O15 `pin`, O16 `unpin` (§74, §75) -/

/-- The pinning effect preserves `WF3` (§49) and `I1`–`I4` (§50–§53): only the pin flags change
(§74, §75 `ok` effects). -/
theorem pinEff_preserves_base {s : S3} (p : Nat) (b : Bool) (hw : WF3 s) (hi : Inv3base s) :
    WF3 (pinEff s p b) ∧ Inv3base (pinEff s p b) :=
  sameA_base hw hi rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl fun q hq x hx => hi.2.2.1 q hq x hx

/-- The pinning effect preserves `AnchorOrder` (§44): only the pin flags change (§74, §75). -/
theorem pinEff_preserves_anchorOrder {s : S3} (p : Nat) (b : Bool) (hao : AnchorOrder s) :
    AnchorOrder (pinEff s p b) :=
  anchorOrder_of (s := s) rfl rfl rfl (effAnchorOK_of_A rfl rfl rfl) fun q hq x hx =>
    hao q hq x hx

/-- The pinning effect preserves `NoDangling` (§54): only the pin flags change (§74, §75). -/
theorem pinEff_preserves_noDangling {s : S3} (p : Nat) (b : Bool) (hnd : NoDangling s) :
    NoDangling (pinEff s p b) :=
  noDangling_skel hnd (skel_of_A rfl) rfl rfl rfl

/-- The pinning effect preserves `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44): only the pin flags change (§74,
§75). -/
theorem pinEff_preserves_anchorOrderHeld {s : S3} (p : Nat) (b : Bool) (h : AnchorOrderHeld s) :
    AnchorOrderHeld (pinEff s p b) :=
  sameA_anchorOrderHeld h rfl rfl rfl rfl

/-- The pinning effect preserves `RootHeldConv` (§40, §49.7): only the pin flags change (§74,
§75). -/
theorem pinEff_preserves_rootHeldConv {s : S3} (p : Nat) (b : Bool) (h : RootHeldConv s) :
    RootHeldConv (pinEff s p b) :=
  sameA_rootHeldConv h rfl rfl

/-- The pinning effect preserves `KInv` (§57; §74, §75 `ok` effects). -/
private theorem pinEff_preserves {s : S3} (p : Nat) (b : Bool) (hinv : KInv s) :
    KInv (pinEff s p b) := by
  obtain ⟨hw, ⟨hb, ho, hnd⟩, hh, -⟩ := hinv
  exact kinv_of_parts (pinEff_preserves_base p b hw hb) (pinEff_preserves_anchorOrder p b ho)
    (pinEff_preserves_noDangling p b hnd) (pinEff_preserves_anchorOrderHeld p b hh)

/-- `pin` preserves `KInv` (§57, §58, §74). -/
theorem pin_preserves {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} (hinv : KInv s)
    (h : PinStep p s (.ok s')) : KInv s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact pinEff_preserves p true hinv

/-- `pin` preserves the auxiliary `KAux` (§40, §49.7; §74 `ok` effect: only the pin flags
change). -/
theorem pin_preserves_kAux {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} (haux : KAux s)
    (h : PinStep p s (.ok s')) : KAux s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact pinEff_preserves_rootHeldConv p true haux

/-- `unpin` preserves `KInv` (§57, §58, §75). -/
theorem unpin_preserves {k : K} {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} (hinv : KInv s)
    (h : UnpinStep k p s (.ok s')) : KInv s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact pinEff_preserves p false hinv

/-- `unpin` preserves the auxiliary `KAux` (§40, §49.7; §75 `ok` effect: only the pin flags
change). -/
theorem unpin_preserves_kAux {k : K} {s s' : S3} {p : Nat} (haux : KAux s)
    (h : UnpinStep k p s (.ok s')) : KAux s' := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  exact pinEff_preserves_rootHeldConv p false haux

/-- Determinism of `pin` (§58, §74): one outcome. -/
theorem pin_det {p : Nat} {s : S3} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 S3} (h₁ : PinStep p s o₁)
    (h₂ : PinStep p s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := Guarded.det h₁ h₂

/-- Determinism of `unpin` (§58, §75): one outcome. -/
theorem unpin_det {k : K} {p : Nat} {s : S3} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 S3} (h₁ : UnpinStep k p s o₁)
    (h₂ : UnpinStep k p s o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := Guarded.det h₁ h₂

    ∀ i (l : List α) j, (l.modify i f)[j]? = (fun a => if i = j then f a else a) <$> l[j]?
  | n, l, 0 => by cases l <;> cases n <;> simp
  | n, [], _+1 => by cases n <;> rfl
  | 0, _ :: l, j+1 => by cases h : l[j]? <;> simp [h, modify]

/-! ## Consequences of `I1` (§50) -/

/-- Under `I1`, two distinct authorities with present effective modes on a leaf have compatible
effective modes, `Observe`/`Observe` (§50, second paragraph). -/
theorem effective_compat {s : S3} (h : I1 s) :
    ∀ a b p m₁ m₂, a ≠ b → effective s a p = some m₁ → effective s b p = some m₂ →
      Compat m₁ m₂ := by
  intro a b p m₁ m₂ hab ha hb
  obtain ⟨x, hx, xa, xp, ex⟩ := effective_some ha
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ya, yp, ey⟩ := effective_some hb
  have obs₁ : x.mode = .observe → m₁ = .observe := fun hm => by
    rcases effOf_cases ex with ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ <;> simp [hm]
  have obs₂ : y.mode = .observe → m₂ = .observe := fun hm => by
    rcases effOf_cases ey with ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ <;> simp [hm]
  by_cases hba : b ∈ s.ancs a
  · have hm : x.mode ∈ descModes s b p := mem_descModes.2 ⟨a, x, hx, xa, xp, hba, rfl⟩
    rcases effOf_cases ey with ⟨h0, -⟩ | ⟨-, hn, rfl⟩
    · simp [h0] at hm
    · have : x.mode = .observe := mode_eq_observe fun e => hn (e ▸ hm)
      exact ⟨obs₁ this, rfl⟩
  by_cases hab' : a ∈ s.ancs b
  · have hm : y.mode ∈ descModes s a p := mem_descModes.2 ⟨b, y, hy, ya, yp, hab', rfl⟩
    rcases effOf_cases ex with ⟨h0, -⟩ | ⟨-, hn, rfl⟩
    · simp [h0] at hm
    · have : y.mode = .observe := mode_eq_observe fun e => hn (e ▸ hm)
      exact ⟨rfl, obs₂ this⟩
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := h a b x y p hab hx hy xa ya xp yp hab' hba
  exact ⟨obs₁ h₁, obs₂ h₂⟩

/-- `effective_exclusive` (§50): under `I1`, an authority with effective `Modify` on a leaf is the
only one with a present effective mode there. -/
theorem effective_exclusive {s : S3} (h : I1 s) {a b p : Nat} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (ha : effective s a p = some .modify) : effective s b p = none := by
  cases hb : effective s b p with
  | none => rfl
  | some m => exact absurd (effective_compat h a b p _ _ hab ha hb).1 (by simp)

/-- Compatibility of effective modes is symmetric (§50). -/
theorem Compat.symm {m₁ m₂ : Mode} (h : Compat m₁ m₂) : Compat m₂ m₁ := ⟨h.2, h.1⟩

/-- `I4` holds in every state (§53, first sentence): a read requires `Init` on every leaf read
(§66.1). -/
theorem i4_always (s : S3) : I4 s := fun _ _ l hl hm h => by rw [h.init l hl] at hm; cases hm

input.summary:
Stage 1 is done. D1–D10 are implemented in Basic, Ops, Invariants, Lemmas and Preserve/Common under formal/Ern/MemoryModel/Access/. `cd formal && ~/.elan/bin/lake build Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.Common` succeeds with no warnings. Each of the five files also compiles silently with `lake env lean`. The grep for sorry/admit/native_decide/axiom/noncomputable/set_option finds nothing in these files. I ran a scratch meta-check (scratchpad/stage1/AllAx.lean) over all 1359 constants of the five modules: every one depends only on propext and Quot.sound, with no Classical.choice.

Spec passages read: v0.1 §38–§57, §58–§75 and the header; arbitration.md, including the follow-up answers Q9 and Q3.

What changed:
- **D1 (§74, §75; B#45)**
  - New `PinOb`. The `S3.pin` field is replaced by `pins : List PinOb`, with `def S3.pin` derived from it, so `s.pin l = false` keeps its meaning.
  - `pinEff s p` appends the obligation `⟨p, footprint s.P p, true⟩`.
  - New `unpinEff s o` deactivates only obligation `o` (via `List.modify`; every other field stays the same by rfl).
  - `UnpinPre k s o` has four fields: obligation `o` exists and is active; its place is usable; `HasRight .modify` on that place; `k.ExternalDone o`.
  - `UnpinStep k o` and `KStep.unpin {o}` are updated.
  - `enterEff` and `allocEff` no longer touch pins (`enterEff` sets `pins := s.pins`). `S3.init` has `pins := []`.
  - The `K` docstring now says `ExternalDone` is applied to obligation identities.
- **D2:** `Grounds` and `RightChain` are added after `HasRight`, with `Decidable` instances.
- **D3:** `TransferPre.noOutsideDerived` takes the ∃ g form, and the new field `dstUsableAfter` covers §63.9.
- **D4 / D5:** `EndUsePre.access` and `FreePre.access` take the ∃ g form with `RightChain ∨ ...AccessOK`. Each gets a new `keptDesc` field for the last sentence of §69.2 and §70.3.
- **D6:** new `AllocStatic.providerUsable`.
- **D7:** new `DerivePre.chainActive`.
- **D8:** `I2` gets the conjunct `(y.active = true → x.active = true)`.
- **D9:** `I5 k s` is defined and is not part of `KInv`.
- **D10:** the `StaticsOK` docstring now cites §47 and §49.
- **Docstrings and headers:** all `Decidable` instances are updated for the new fields. Module headers now cite `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`. The `KAux` docstring now says it is not a clause of §57 (D11 wording), because no later stage can edit Common.lean.

Examples in Invariants.lean:
- New state `s4 := pinEff s0 0`.
- `UnpinPre K0 s4 0` holds; `¬ UnpinPre K0 s0 0` (no obligation exists); `¬ EndUsePre K0 s4 0` (the leaf is pinned).
- A §75 witness: with two obligations on leaf 0, unpinning obligation 0 leaves the leaf pinned, while unpinning the only obligation unpins it.
- The §63.8 example is restated with the new §63.4 form plus the §63.9 conjunct.
- All existing `decide` examples still pass with the new fields: TransferPre, EndUsePre, FreePre, AllocStatic and DerivePre.

New general lemmas in Lemmas.lean:
- `mem_chain`.
- `hasRight_iff_grounds` (HasRight ↔ ∃ g, Grounds).
- I2 accessors: `I2.origin_active`, `I2.ancs_active_lt`, `I2.ancs_active` (under I2, every authority in the origin chain of an active authority is active).
- Pinning lemmas:
  - `S3.pin_iff`, `S3.pin_congr`;
  - `pin_pinEff`;
  - `pins_unpinEff`, `pin_unpinEff_iff`, `pin_of_pin_unpinEff`;
  - one `pins_*Eff` lemma per pin-free effect: derive, split, release, transfer, depend, store, enter, exit, write3, endUse, free, alloc.
- One private helper, `getElem?_modify'`. The core `List.getElem?_modify` depends on Classical.choice, so I proved my own version.

Changed proofs: `SameSkel.i2` now carries the active conjunct. `addAuth_preserves` gained the hypothesis `hxa : x.active = true`. That hypothesis comes from the spec (§60.1 and §61.1 require the source to be active), and the proof cannot work without it once I2 changes: a `derive` with an empty region from an inactive source would break I2. The lemma has no users outside Lemmas.lean.

Not done: per the brief, I did not run the full build; the Access stage-2 files (Preserve/*), Main.lean and modules outside Access/ are expected to fail until later stages run. Line numbers for every declaration are in `changed`; the stage-2 changes needed, the git-state note and the §63.4/§69.2/§70.3 reading are in `open`.
